name: zsnd_sample_play_on_a3d
description: zSndSample::PlayOnA3D starts an A3D voice, updates optional world-position state, sets mode, plays, and commits deferred A3D settings.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage includes no-position simple playback and non-null world-position playback through zSndSample::PlayA3D.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x49fa60 validates create-guard and flag-0x10 gates, backend play-handle acquisition, optional world-position Update3DDispatch path, spatialization enable/disable, mode set, play call, and A3D deferred-settings commit.
The native smokes verify no-position A3D gain/mode/play/commit behavior and world-position A3D position, velocity, gain, doppler, mode, play, and commit behavior.
